claims.statement: Giuliano della Rovere, an enemy of the Borgias. Commissioned Michelangelo's Sistine ceiling and Raphael's rooms in the Vatican. Leonardo was in Florence and Milan throughout his reign.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Standard papal chronologies.
